comment: Load addresses for the app-loader ELF. THE source of truth: tools/mk-app-elf.py reads this, and the SDK ships it as the bundle's manifest.json. U-Boot's compiled-in bootcmd (board/synthstrom/deluge/uboot/configs/deluge_defconfig) is the one place these addresses are necessarily duplicated — change them together. SDRAM is 64 MB at 0x0C000000.
